title: Battle of Port Arthur
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Port Arthur", at revision 1376392782, opens: "The Battle of Port Arthur  of 8–9 February 1904 marked the commencement of the Russo-Japanese War. It began with a surprise night attack by a squadron of Japanese destroyers on the neutral Russian fleet anchored at Port Arthur, Manchuria, and continued with an engagement the following morning; further skirmishing off Port Arthur would continue until May 1904. The attack ended inconclusively." Wikidata item Q1363925, whose own description reads "1904 naval battle of the Russo-Japanese War". That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does.

actors.note: Q1363925 gives the Empire of Japan (Q188712) as a participant; russo-japanese-war reads the same item as `japan`
